fixes.1: Removed hex plaques. Pixel ZH is awaited by the existing scene preload/create barrier and explicitly by the fixture. Both main-room paint signatures and the glyph cache depend on font readiness. Unsupported characters use a 12px platform CJK raster thresholded to a binary mask. Complete ink bounds come from a larger scratch canvas. Main-room labels paint after the wall/counter projection so thin columns survive. Measuring, 20-code-point name limits and ellipsis remain; text has one art pixel of horizontal padding per edge.
fixes.2: Default cabinets now have dark walnut recesses, raised panels, inner cove molding, honey bevels, brass U pulls, top-left highlights and bottom-right shading. Counter, back-bar and window cabinet calls share the same painter. Walnut, marble, pink and gold retain separate palette ramps.
fixes.3: Pickup has a single recessed cavity, horizontal shadow bands, polished steel shelves and two small heat lamps; vertical door divisions are removed. Shelf planes, all six passSlot anchors and PASS_BELL are unchanged. Plates and bell remain live scene overlays.
fixes.4: T runner now has layered woven binding, cream piping, broad diamond motifs, finished end embroidery and a finished welcome mat for purchased-rug configurations. Motif cells are at least 4 art pixels. The T footprint, uninterrupted join and purchased-rug separation remain.
fixes.5: The default sill_none deliberately leaves the sill clean. Existing equipped cactus/tulips/bonsai options still use native crisp grid painters at the same anchor.

intentionalTestChanges.src/render/sign-lettering.test.ts: The old no-DOM distinct hexadecimal-mask expectation becomes fixed-size binary replacement masks and a real platform-raster test. Native Chinese scratch pixels use the new 24x32 buffer with centered ink; bottom strokes and alpha threshold stay checked. Added complete OPEN/营业中 fitting checks at projected plaque widths. Accent distinction, name limits, measuring, ellipsis and save round trips remain.
intentionalTestChanges.src/render/rug-join.test.ts: Top and side binding probes now admit the two woven linen colors instead of requiring the old single flat stripe. Existing T-continuity, footprint, edge and purchased-rug separation tests remain.
intentionalTestChanges.src/render/phaser/cafe-scene-sign-readin: New tests: hold the real preload/create path until the font resolves; invalidate both layers with time frozen when FontFace becomes loaded.
intentionalTestChanges.src/render/room-sign-projection.test.ts: New regression: final lettering pixels paint after the plane resample and remain half-room-pixel rectangles.

qa.offlineCaveats: Native architecture boards use actual painters and actual JS glyph masks fed macOS CoreText rasters. They omit runtime projection, legacy windows/props, characters and lighting. Window openings and the six sample plate marks are QA stand-ins, not runtime replacements. Browser Canvas/Phaser captures are deliberately left to the user.
